name: Heart statue
about: A big red heart standing on a stone base, with a pink shine.

layers.name: Base
layers.tip: A square of stone bricks, 3 by 3.

layers.name: Point
layers.tip: The point of the heart: one red wool in the middle of the base.

layers.name: Row 2
layers.tip: Three red wool, in a line from left to right.

layers.name: Row 4
layers.tip: Seven red wool: the widest row.

layers.name: Row 5
layers.tip: Seven again, with pink wool second from the left for the shine.

layers.name: Top
layers.tip: Two bumps of two wool each, with a gap in the middle.
